title: Mixture-of-Depths plus Mirror compute/function routing
hypothesis: At an identical token-depth compute budget, a role-conditioned Mirror view recovers distinct token functions beyond MoD routing alone; measure whether it improves the quality/bytes/active-FLOPs frontier over a generic shared rank-2 residual.
mirror_coordinate: A binary task-role code selects a small Givens angle on the first hidden channel pair, independently of the token's depth route
logical_multiplicity: Two token roles x two compute routes (one or two blocks)

development.selection: No hyperparameter tuning; verify fixed protocol and implementation.

controls: MoD routing alone, same fixed top-50% deep-token route
MoD plus generic shared rank-2 role residual
MoD plus role-conditioned Mirror Givens view
dense two-block independent compute upper reference
generic direct role-angle table with the same two scalar codes and Givens operation

storage.authority: actual serialized NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: rank-2 residual basis and role coefficients

compute.report_active_block FLOPs: count only routed tokens; separately include view/residual MACs

success_gate: All three fresh worlds: Mirror NRMSE <=1e-4, same exact deep-token fraction as MoD, and a better actual-byte/quality point than MoD alone. Mirror-specific advantage requires either >=10% lower total bytes at matched quality or >=10% lower active compute at matched bytes than the shared rank-2 control.
failure_gate: Mirror misses the utility gate, or the generic shared rank-2 or direct scalar-angle control matches its quality with equal/lower bytes and active compute.
boundaries: Synthetic token-function mechanism only; no trained Transformer, language NLL, GPU, energy, or capacity evidence.
Teacher contains an explicit role-conditioned first-pair Givens view; this is favorable to Mirror.
MoD compute allocation and role function choice are separately logged; combination count is not called capacity.
amendment: A1-A6; A6 restores A0-A3 shared/input precision and is the authoritative audited replay.
accounting_correction: A6 records float64 shared/input state and float32 View state as actually serialized and decoded. Direct angle table is an exact generic control.
